fact: The RNPP, deployed since 2019 under a public-private partnership, was reviewed on 6-7 May 2026 at a workshop of ONECI, the operator SEMLEX and the project's assistant contracting authority to set the 2026 action plan.
title: MISE EN ŒUVRE DU RNPP: L'ONECI ET SES PARTENAIRES DÉFINISSENT LES ORIENTATIONS STRATÉGIQUES 2026
